summary: Citizens reported fish mortality at multiple points along the shoreline.
Dissolved oxygen was below the configured observation threshold at Site 04.
Heavy rainfall was recorded in the surrounding area shortly before the incident.
A recent satellite-derived anomaly was detected near the affected water body.
Independent field verification of dissolved oxygen is not yet available.
Laboratory water chemistry testing could help investigate a possible pollution-related explanation but is not yet available.
Additional citizen verification could confirm the spatial extent of the reported mortality.
